purpose: Issue 158 macOS release CLI scan profiling; measures total process time, native scan, JSON write, peak RSS and cancellation latency without running unit or UI tests.

conditions.host: macOS arm64; same host and warmed filesystem cache for all paired runs
conditions.fixture: fresh temporary tree per scenario; no symlinks or hardlinks; read-only scanner
conditions.order: alternating baseline/candidate per scenario after one warmup each
conditions.statistics: median and nearest-rank p95 of wall, scan, JSON and RSS; cancellation latency from SIGINT to child exit
conditions.limits: 30-second timeout and 64 MiB stdout cap per invocation; no test runners
interpretation: The hex-path serialization change improves JSON time without changing the report schema or scanned entry count.
These local warm-cache measurements are not a Mole comparison or a cold-start claim.
Cancellation samples terminate after SIGINT and therefore retain variable observed entry counts.
Actual App UI first-result and browsing latency remain unmeasured by this CLI benchmark.
